judgment: It is good to hold firm.
image: Thunder inside the marsh: Going Along.
So the noble one, as dusk comes on,
goes in to feast and rest.
lines: Out of the gate, dealings have merit.
Going along, what is sought is granted.
It is good to stay and hold firm.
Trust on the road, brought to light —
The king offers at the western mountain.

notes.name_en: 隨 is following along after; 'Going Along', not Wilhelm's 'Following'.
notes.L6: 亨 here 享, offering/sacrifice at 西山 the western mountain.
